prose:
A Hacker News headline links to Reuters coverage of Anthropic’s trading debut and highlights an intraday valuation. Reuters was inaccessible. A later Techmeme excerpt of the same article reports a $97.17 close after an $111.50 opening trade, rather than a closing valuation at the headline’s intraday peak.

The indexed Reuters closing market-cap figure and CNBC’s fully diluted figure use different apparent share-count conventions. Those totals should not be treated as interchangeable without inspecting the underlying counts. The Reuters article itself was not readable, and these are attributed historical reports rather than a current stock quote.
highlights: Later excerpt updates the intraday headline
Offering open and close are different prices
Basic and diluted valuations can differ
Underlying share counts were not inspected
